key_provisions_or_claims: Establishes Fukushima reconstruction basic policy and Prime Minister-certified Fukushima Reconstruction and Revitalization Plans.
Special measures for evacuation-lifted zones, specified reconstruction hub zones and return/residence zones.
Regulatory exceptions for industry revival and new-industry projects in the Fukushima International Research Industrial City zone.
Plans may include robot R&D hubs and robot product/technology test projects.
Creates the Fukushima Institute for Research, Education and Innovation (F-REI) covering robotics, decommissioning and agriculture R&D.
annotation.summary_en: Japan's Act on Special Measures for the Reconstruction and Revitalization of Fukushima (2012, current revision 2026) sets the reconstruction basic policy, plan certification, special measures for evacuation-lifted areas and industry, and the F-REI research institute. Robotics appears only as a designated R&D and industrial-cluster field, with no robot-specific safety or liability rules.
